# Datamining PTS: Season 22 Appalachian Modern Living Preview

![Datamining PTS: Season 22 Appalachian Modern Living Preview](/uploads/538_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The next season will be dominated by all the well-known **brands** of the **Fallout universe**. From **Abraxo** to **Garrahan** & **Nuka Cola** to **Sunset Sarsaparilla** and **Vault Tec**. The name of the new season is:

### Appalachian Modern Living

This can be done e.g. can be recognized by the picture of the “End of Season Art”. We currently don't know when season 22 will be released. But we can already see what rewards await us.
